headlines.title: Seagate Stocks Jump 8.27% as Anthropic IPO Rekindles AI Storage Trade
headlines.summary: Mass-capacity drives are back in favor, backed by a 57.3% gross margin and record free cash flow.

headlines.title: Seagate and Western Digital Climb 4% Despite Tech Profit-Taking After Anthropic’s IPO Debut; SanDisk Edges Higher
headlines.summary: While Anthropic's blockbuster debut sent tech into a sell-the-news spiral, two hard drive makers shrugged it off and SanDisk and Micron stalled. What do spinning disks have that flash and memory chips lack, and can it last?

headlines.title: Seagate Soars 6%, Coherent Up 8% as AI Stocks Rebound on Anthropic IPO Day
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysSeagate jumped 6% today as AI hardware stocks rebounded on the day of Anthropic’s IPO, and Coherent rose with it. Seagate had no news of its own, and its swings have tracked AI sentiment more than its business.

headlines.title: Adaptive Storage Launch Could Be A Game Changer For Seagate Stock (STX)
headlines.summary: Seagate Technology Holdings recently launched the FireCuda Forge, the first hard drive built on its Alkemi intelligent storage platform. It combines SSD-like responsiveness with HDD capacity through real-time adaptive caching across 8TB and 20TB models, priced from US$699 and US$899. The Alkemi platform brings enterprise-style intelligent data tiering into consumer systems.

headlines.title: SanDisk Slides 4% Ahead of 8-for-1 Stock Split as NAND Glut Worries Linger; Micron Drops 3%, Seagate Edges Lower
headlines.summary: SanDisk has more than tripled this year, yet a single analyst warning about oversupply is rattling memory stocks just before its split. Why is SanDisk absorbing the sharpest blow while Micron, Seagate and Western Digital hold steadier?

description: Seagate Technology Holdings plc engages in providing data storage solutions in Singapore, the United States, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company offers External and internal hard drives; external and internal solid-state drives (SSDs); enterprise hard drives and SSDs; data storage systems; network attached storage (NAS) hard drives; video and analytics hard drives; and hyperscale and cloud solution. It offers its products for Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Surveillance & Security, and telecommunication industry. The company sells its products primarily to original equipment manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Singapore.
